arguments.value: 25-year-old G2P0 woman at 37+1 weeks with prenatally diagnosed fetal gastroschisis, confirmed by serial ultrasound showing a 34 mm right paraumbilical abdominal wall defect with exteriorized bowel and fetal growth restriction; delivered by cesarean at 37+2 weeks, newborn underwent silo bag placement with delayed closure followed by adhesiolysis, appendectomy, and umbiloplasty, and recovered well.
